show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Sustainable Investing 4: Emanuel Citron – Sourcing Sustainable Managers (Capital Allocators, EP.142)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. We then turn to investor interest in the space, risks,
Volary's backing of Renewable Resources Group, and the future of Impact Investing. It's the same thing as regular investing,
but it uses an extra set of filters, and that's using ESG factors to identify risks and opportunities
in the material economic aspects of a business.

thesis: The episode introduces Manny Citron, managing partner at Volaree Capital, who co-founded the firm in 2017 to invest in asset management businesses and companies generating positive social and environmental impact. Citron explains that his interest in this space was influenced by a formative eight-month motorcycle trip across Africa and the Middle East, which taught him about the value of people and how far a dollar can go in different contexts.
